@@U01033@@
You haven't heard the half of it yet.
There’s more.
I know it backwards and forwards,
it’s all like that.
Ah, the time it’s cost me!
A waste!
A perfect contradiction, you see,
the totally nonsensical is as deep a mystery
to wise men as to fools.
It’s a game, my friend,
a game they've made an art,
as old as it is new.
Its purpose is always to spread lies instead of truth,
all by proclaiming the Three-in-One and
One-in-Three. It’s a safe choice.
You can chatter and teach in the same breath,
and no one to bother you.
Who wants to waste his time on fools?
Besides, people hear words,
and what's their first thought?
That behind every word there must be sense.

@@U01035@@
(Continuing.)

@@U01036@@
The lofty light
Of science’s might
From all the world is hidden!
Refuse to think,
It comes in a wink,
It flies on wings unbidden!

@@U01038@@
What’s this drivel she’s babbling at us?
My head’s about to split. It’s like hearing
a hundred thousand fools in chorus.

@@U01040@@
Enough, enough, excellent sibyl!
Bring on your potion and be sure to fill the cup full.
translation:
@@U01033@@
你还没听完一半。
还有更多。
我知道它的前后，
都是这样的。
啊，这花费了我的时间！
浪费！
你看，这是一个完美的矛盾，
完全荒谬的事同样是一个深奥的谜
对智者如对愚者。
这是一场游戏，我的朋友，
他们把游戏变成了艺术，
既旧又新。
其目的始终是传播谎言而不是真相，
所有这一切都是通过宣扬三合一和
三分之一。这是一个安全的选择。
你可以边聊天边教学，
也没有人来打扰你。
谁愿意把时间浪费在傻瓜身上呢？
此外，人们听到的话，
他们的第一个想法是什么？
每句话背后都必须有道理。

@@U01035@@
（继续。）

@@U01036@@
高远的光
科学的力量
对全世界来说都是隐藏的！
拒绝思考，
一眨眼的功夫，
它不请自来地展翅飞翔！

@@U01038@@
她对我们胡言乱语是什么？
我的头快要裂开了。就像听到的一样
十万个傻瓜齐声合唱。

@@U01040@@
够了，够了，优秀的女预言家！
带上你的药水，并确保将杯子装满。
